title: seseli asperum
intro: Seseli asperum, commonly known as Rough Seseli, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Seseli asperum are attributed to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, while also possessing antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of Seseli asperum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
